name: agenthub-workers
description: Bridge all Multi-Agent Hub workers (zcode / antigravity / codebuddy / codebuddy-cn / mimocode / github-copilot / minimaxcode / traecode) as native ZCode subagents, with a blocking ask MCP bridge (hub_ask), a concurrent dispatch skill and a /hub-status command.

description_i18n.en: Bridge all Multi-Agent Hub workers as native ZCode subagents, with a blocking ask MCP bridge (hub_ask), a concurrent dispatch skill and a /hub-status command.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把 Multi-Agent Hub 全部 8 个 worker 桥接为 ZCode 原生子智能体；附阻塞式派发桥接 MCP（hub_ask 一次调用出结果）、多 worker 并发调度技能与 /hub-status 状态命令。
